title: an explicitly typed let does not make its anonymous action recursive
purpose: Invalid anonymous action forms are rejected before the program runs.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage; static analysis may reject it, otherwise execution fails. Either way the program must not complete.

provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.2: a local binding becomes visible only after its initializer has been checked; an anonymous action cannot refer to the let that will hold it (#318). The program would print, so empty stdout also shows it did not run.
